members.name: banking_intents_e9_m0
members.instructions: A customer sent this message to a digital bank's support chat. Which intent best describes what the customer wants? Pick the single most specific intent.

criteria.activate_my_card: Activating a newly received card; can't activate card.
criteria.age_limit: Minimum age to open an account; can children/teens have an account.
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: ANY message mentioning Apple Pay, Google Pay, Android Pay or Apple Watch, including topping up with them (this overrides every other intent).
criteria.atm_support: Finding ATMs, which ATMs accept the card, using the card at an ATM in general.
criteria.automatic_top_up: Auto top-up feature: does it exist, how to set it up, its limits.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: Customer explicitly made or received a bank TRANSFER (not a deposit) and their own balance has not updated / incoming transfer not showing in the account yet; asks to check that a transfer they made (e.g. from a UK account) a few hours ago went through alright.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: Any DEPOSIT not showing: deposited money, money they put into the account, cash or a cheque and it is not showing in the balance yet / balance unchanged after a deposit / cheque slow to clear.
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Cannot add a beneficiary/payee, beneficiary not allowed; also the customer simply can't / is unable to / is not allowed to make a transfer to an account (no failure, error or decline mentioned), or a transfer was not cleared.
criteria.cancel_transfer: Wants to cancel, revert or take back a transfer/transaction they already sent (e.g. sent to the wrong account). Not cancelling a purchase/order of goods (that is request_refund).
criteria.card_about_to_expire: Card is expiring or expired; how to get a replacement for an expiring card.
criteria.card_acceptance: Where the card is accepted; will merchants/shops accept this card.
criteria.card_arrival: Ordered card has not arrived yet; tracking a card that was sent.
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How the card will be delivered to me / how long card delivery takes; when it will arrive; can it be delivered by a date or expedited, delivery time to a country.
criteria.card_linking: Linking a card to the account/app; making a new card show up in the app.
criteria.card_not_working: The card itself does not work / stopped working / never goes through anywhere ('what's going on with my card'), rather than one specific payment being declined.
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: Charged a fee for paying with the card; hidden fees or unexpected fees on card payments.
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: The customer does not recognise a PAYMENT, PURCHASE or transaction on the account/app/statement or says they didn't make it or that a payment on the statement is wrong (wording mentions a payment, purchase, transaction, or something they didn't buy).
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: Complaint that the exchange rate applied or charged was wrong/incorrect/bad, e.g. on a card purchase or payment abroad (not cash withdrawals).
criteria.card_swallowed: The ATM kept / ate / swallowed the card.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: Fee charged for withdrawing cash at an ATM; are there ATM withdrawal fees.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: App shows a cash withdrawal or cash amount the customer did not make, take out or receive, even if they think someone has their card details.
criteria.change_pin: How or where to change, update or set up a new PIN.
criteria.compromised_card: Card details stolen/copied/compromised, someone else may be using the card for payments, fraud on card (if the issue is an unrecognised cash withdrawal, use cash_withdrawal_not_recognised).
criteria.country_support: Which countries the service or cards are available in; can people outside the UK (e.g. in the EU) get an account or card.
criteria.declined_card_payment: A card payment at a shop or online was declined/rejected (a transaction 'not approved' is failed_transfer).
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: ATM cash withdrawal was declined / not authorised / couldn't withdraw money.
criteria.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: An unknown or unauthorised direct debit; also a generic unknown/unauthorised CHARGE (wording only says 'charge', with no mention of a payment, purchase or buying) or wanting to dispute a charge or debit.
criteria.disposable_card_limits: Limits/restrictions on disposable virtual cards, how many times they can be used.
criteria.edit_personal_details: Change name, address or personal details on the account.
criteria.exchange_rate: Informational questions about exchange rates: what they are, where to see them, how they're calculated (no complaint that a charged rate was wrong).
criteria.exchange_via_app: How to exchange currencies in the app.
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: A small unexplained extra amount of about one pound/dollar/euro (£1, $1, €1) on the statement or a payment. Any message about a £1/$1/€1 charge or purchase belongs here, even if it is pending or the customer does not recognise it. Also questions about unexplained 'extra charges' on the statement.
criteria.failed_transfer: A transfer explicitly failed, was unsuccessful, gave an error message, or a transfer/transaction wasn't approved; includes errors paying for a flat/mortgage.
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which fiat currencies can be held or exchanged.
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: How to get a disposable virtual card; who can get one.
criteria.get_physical_card: The PIN for a new card: haven't received the PIN, can't find the PIN, how to get the card PIN, whether I can create my own PIN right away for a new card.
criteria.getting_virtual_card: How to get a (non-disposable) virtual card; where is my virtual card.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: Card lost or stolen; found a lost card; freeze a lost card.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: Phone lost, stolen or left somewhere.
criteria.order_physical_card: Getting or ordering a physical/plastic card to hold in hand, how to order a card, fees for a new card, which places/countries cards can be shipped to.
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgot passcode / login code / password; reset passcode.
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment/purchase is still pending.
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal is pending / shows in progress, e.g. the ATM didn't give money but the app shows it pending.
criteria.pending_top_up: Top-up pending, taking long, not sure it went through, funds not available yet.
criteria.pending_transfer: A transfer is still pending/in progress.
criteria.pin_blocked: PIN blocked or account/card blocked after wrong PIN attempts; unblock PIN.
criteria.receiving_money: How to receive money; can someone send me money; receiving salary.
criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: A refund the customer is waiting for has not appeared.
criteria.request_refund: Wants a refund for something bought; how to get a refund; no longer wants an item and wants to cancel the purchase/order.
criteria.reverted_card_payment?: A card payment was reverted/returned back to the account, or a purchase they paid for no longer shows.
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Which cards and currencies are supported for top-ups/payments.
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Fee for topping up by bank transfer; also any question about SWIFT transfers.
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: Fee for topping up with a card.
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Topping up / depositing with cash or cheque.
criteria.top_up_failed: Top-up failed, declined, got an error, or something is wrong with the top-up so they can't access the money (including card declined for top-up).
criteria.top_up_reverted: Top-up went through and then the money was taken back/disappeared, or a top-up (e.g. crypto) isn't working and they ask what happened to the money (no card mentioned).
criteria.topping_up_by_card: How to top up with a card; card top-up where the money disappeared.
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: Charged a fee for a transfer ('I thought transfers were free'); a higher fee for banking abroad; also bare 'why was I charged'.
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to transfer money into the account / top up by bank transfer.
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: A transfer the customer sent out has not arrived: the recipient (friend, landlord, retailer) hasn't got it, or a transfer made days ago still isn't there / hasn't gone through.
criteria.transfer_timing: Asks HOW LONG a transfer takes, or how much longer they must wait for a transfer they are waiting on (e.g. from the US/Europe), without saying it is pending or that a recipient is missing it.
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: Identity verification is failing / can't verify identity.
criteria.verify_my_identity: How to verify identity; what documents are needed.
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Source of funds: where the money in the account came from, seeing available money and its source, verifying source of funds.
criteria.verify_top_up: Top-up verification code / verifying the card used for a top-up; why a top-up needs verifying.
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Is the card Visa or Mastercard; choosing Visa or Mastercard.
criteria.why_verify_identity: Why identity verification / personal info is needed.
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: ATM gave a different amount of cash than requested.
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: Wrong or too-high exchange rate applied to cash taken out at an ATM, or to an amount of cash.
